defines.name: UPDATE_RD
defines.value: "UPDATE  `%s`.`%s` SET rd = (close - y_close) / y_close * 100 WHERE close >0 AND y_close >0 AND rd = 0;"

defines.name: UPDATE_MA
defines.value: "UPDATE  `%s`.`%s` SET ma = turnover / volume WHERE turnover >0 AND volume >0 AND ma=0;"

defines.name: UPDATE_AM
defines.value: "UPDATE  `%s`.`%s` SET am = (high - low) / close * 100 WHERE high >0 AND close >0 AND am = 0;"

defines.name: UPDATE_KP
defines.value: "UPDATE  `%s`.`%s` SET k_price = ma WHERE rd >5 OR rd <-5 OR am >6;"

defines.name: UPDATE_DIR
defines.value: "UPDATE `%s`.`dir` SET `dir`=(SELECT dir FROM `%s`.`%s` ORDER BY idprice DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE `ID`='%s';"

defines.name: ALTER_DIR_PKEY
defines.value: "ALTER TABLE `%s`.`dir` DROP PRIMARY KEY, ADD PRIMARY KEY(`iddir`, `time`);"

defines.name: INSERT_DIR
defines.value: "INSERT INTO `%s`.`dir` (`stockid`,`dir`,`k_price`) VALUES('%s', (SELECT `dir` FROM `%s`.`%s` ORDER BY idprice DESC LIMIT 1),%s);"
